create_schedule_sampler: create a named schedule sampler using create_named_schedule_sampler with name and diffusion object
sample_timesteps: sample weighted timesteps for a diffusion batch using ScheduleSampler sample method
build_uniform_sampler: build a UniformSampler that returns equal weights for all diffusion timesteps
update_loss_weights: update loss-aware sampler weights using LossAwareSampler update_with_local_losses with timesteps and losses
create_loss_second_moment_resampler: create a LossSecondMomentResampler that resamples timesteps based on the second moment of historical losses
